cohort: 64,506 pregnant cancer survivors and 18,687,217 pregnant women without cancer
finding: Pregnant cancer survivors had significantly higher odds for a number of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes compared to pregnant women without cancer.
mod_finding: Pregnant cancer survivors had higher odds of cesarean section (aOR 1.27 [95% CI 1.19-1.37]) and labor induction (aOR 1.17 [95% CI 1.07-1.29]).
